# CanvasFlow Agent Instructions

CanvasFlow is a generative UI prototype for the Auto-Link company competition.

When contributing:

- Keep changes small enough to review in one pull request.
- Prefer typed React components and explicit data models over unstructured objects.
- Add or update Vitest tests when behavior changes.
- Run `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm test`, and `npm run build` before asking for review.
- Do not commit secrets, personal data, API keys, or local `.env` files.
- Describe agent-generated work honestly in the PR description.
